_about: A player's career story (scripts/sim/CareerTale.gd). Each angle declares the slots its phrases may use; CareerTale.validate rejects any other. Numbers come in ready-made from the slots ("31 votes", "1 game"), so a phrase can change the words around a number but never the number. Voice: the senior coach (director 2026-11-10): we/our for the club, you only for a promise the coach made. One phrase is picked per player, from his id, so his story reads the same every time.

coach: We took {first} at pick {pick} in the {year} {draft}.
{first} came to us at pick {pick} in the {year} {draft}.
His first game for us was {when}.
You promised him {games} in a row in {year}, and he played them all.
You promised him {games} in a row in {year}, then left him out after {played}.
From {from}, he won the {year} Brownlow with {votes}.
He was with us for the {years} {flags}.
He played {games} for us and left after {year}.
He played {games} for {club} and left after {year}.
